national.headline: Pakistani astronaut Zeeshan Ali to fly on China's Shenzhou-24 mission
national.line: Zeeshan Ali will be the first Pakistani to go on an orbital space mission with China on November 25.

national.headline: Balochistan offers large rewards for information on terrorists
national.line: Balochistan government offers up to Rs250 million for intelligence on most-wanted terrorists in the province.

national.headline: Legal community calls for repeal of 26th and 27th Constitutional Amendments
national.line: Legal and civil society members demand repeal of constitutional amendments following remarks by PPP Chairman Bilawal Bhutto-Zardari.

national.headline: New sales tax zones to be set up in four major cities
national.line: Four major taxpayer units in Pakistan will have separate sales tax zones to improve collection, Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif was informed.

national.headline: Imran Khan urges PTI to broaden political alliances
national.line: Imran Khan directed the PTI core committee to expand its political alliance and engage with Maulana Fazlur Rehman and other opposition parties.

national.headline: Sindh launches digital gateway for youth's banking, education, and jobs
national.line: The Sindh Youth Card will provide young people with a support system for banking, education, and jobs.

national.headline: Petroleum dealers threaten strike over unmet demands, including 30-day fuel price fix
national.line: Pakistan Petroleum Dealers Association warns of petrol pump closures unless the government fixes fuel prices for 30 days.

national.headline: Punjab holds over 60% of senior federal posts, Senate body informed
national.line: A Senate subcommittee was told that Punjab holds 60.17 percent of senior positions in the Federal Secretariat.

international.headline: COP31 climate negotiations collapse without a deal
international.line: Climate negotiations at COP31 in Antalya ended without a deal, highlighting global divisions.

international.headline: Israeli strikes kill 7 in Gaza, including Hamas security director
international.line: Israeli airstrikes killed seven people in Gaza, including Hamas's director of internal security, despite an existing ceasefire.

international.headline: South Korea reports Russian jets entered its air defence zone
international.line: South Korean authorities stated that several Russian military aircraft breached its air defence zone.

international.headline: Gaza health ministry declares 'epidemic alert' due to meningitis rise
international.line: Gaza's Health Ministry declared an epidemic alert following a sharp increase in meningitis infections and 15 related deaths this year.

international.headline: Iran vows to counter US naval blockade, seeks $290bn damages
international.line: Iran pledged to use all means to counter a US naval blockade and claimed its courts ordered Washington to pay $290 billion in damages.

international.headline: UN food agency warns wars jeopardize aid for 7.3 million more people
international.line: The UN food agency chief warned that ongoing wars threaten food aid for an additional 7.3 million people, increasing costs by $727 million.

international.headline: Nvidia reinstates Jensen Huang as CEO after security clearance
international.line: Nvidia reinstated CEO Jensen Huang after US officials confirmed he posed no national security risk, following an alleged spy scandal.

international.headline: Portugal pledges full support for Pakistan's GSP+ status
international.line: Portugal's Minister of State and Foreign Affairs Paulo Rangel assured Pakistan of his country's full support for EU GSP+ status.
